announcements.title: 0.0.1-3 is out, and Codex works again
announcements.body: Choosing Codex asked for a model it no longer has, so the run failed on its first turn. The models offered are the ones Codex actually has today. Linux gets automatic updates for the first time. A project no longer shows the runs of the one you had open before it, the Docs list appears as the agent writes it, and a note written for the agent stops being read as the document's first line.

announcements.title: Welcome to the first public build
announcements.body: Nexus Studio now updates itself. Downloads and release notes stay on the public releases page, and nothing about your projects leaves this machine.
